1: Jab zameen ko zor se hilaya jayega, jo us ke saath qayamat ke din hoga,
2: aur zameen apne andar se har cheez bahar nikal degi, yani murde aur doosri cheezein,
3: aur insan hayran ho kar kahega: “Zameen ko kya hua ke woh hil aur kaanp rahi hai?”
4: Us bare din zameen un neik aur bure aamaal ki khabar degi jo us par kiye gaye,
5: kyunke Allah ne usey yeh sikhaya hoga aur is ka hukm diya hoga.
6: Us bare din, jis mein zameen kaampegi, log hisaab ki jagah par giroh dar giroh aayenge, taake woh aamaal dekh lein jo unhon ne duniya mein kiye.
7: Pas jis ne ek chhoti si cheenti ke wazan ke barabar koi neik ya achha amal kiya, woh usey apne saamne dekhega.
8: Aur jis ne us ke barabar koi bura amal kiya, woh bhi usey apne saamne dekhega.
